SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.month_date, '%m월') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.TOTAL_PRICE), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_date UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') ) m LEFT JOIN ORDERS o ON DATE_FORMAT(o.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(m.month_date, '%Y-%m') AND o.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED','REFUND') GROUP BY m.month_date ORDER BY m.month_date ASC

pi.IMG_URL,

pf.TITLE AS FEATURE_TITLE, pf.CONTENT AS FEATURE_CONTENT

mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID AS RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID AS USER_ID, R.GUEST_NAME AS GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE AS GUEST_PHONE, R.RENTAL_STATUS AS RENTAL_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(R.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(R.RETURN_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS RETURN_DATE, R.RETURN_ZIPCODE AS RETURN_ZIPCODE, R.RETURN_ADDRESS AS RETURN_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS AS RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS, DATE_FORMAT(R.RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LIMIT 1) AS IMG_URL FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_STATUS IN ('RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RETURN_PICKED', 'RETURN_COMPLETED') ORDER BY R.RETURN_REQUESTED_AT DESC

DATE_FORMAT(RF.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS IMG_URL
FROM REFUND RF LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON RF.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID
GROUP BY RF.REFUND_ID ORDER BY RF.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 50

FROM ORDER_EXCHANGE E LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON E.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID
